text: Pressing F 222m from nearest settlement says only 'Too close to another settlement.' with no minimum distance or direction; player must guess how far to walk. Repeated twice (x2).
Objective 7 progress bar label reads 'bers 5/10' -- 'Members' is clipped on the left of the HUD objective panel.

Claimant sheet: choice 3 description renders 'Nothing now    but if the claimant wins anyway' - a dash glyph is missing (blank gap). Odds (half the time) and relation sizes (+15/+8/-10) not stated; 'a little goodwill' vs 'friendlier' is vague.

Load screen has one slot for the world; returning to Main Menu autosaved over the manual save made with the claimant sheet up, so the choice could not be retried with another option.
